title: Microsoft Purview: new Data Security Posture Management experience
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, portal controls, assessment limits and agent licensing statements are supported. It distinguishes the documented generally available experience from the government-cloud roadmap target and reports the differing SCU provisioning guidance. Two checklist steps still lack corresponding controls-table rows, despite being labelled as outside the table.
